name: Edertal (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of white charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Edertal (a black eight-pointed star on yellow above blue waves).
history: Municipal flag of Edertal; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Edertal arms — black star on yellow
